original_recommendation.title: Run a controlled incremental scale test on TikTok
original_recommendation.whats_happening: Current spend produced 411 conversions at CPA ~14.99 and reported ROAS 10.41, indicating efficient performance in this dataset but only for a snapshot.
what_you_should_do: Design a controlled incremental budget test (increase spend in steps) on this TikTok campaign while monitoring CPA, conversion rate, and ROAS.
Run the test with measurement guards: pre-defined test period, holdout or control group if possible, and strict monitoring of CPA and revenue reconciliation.
Pause scaling if CPA rises materially or ROAS drops below the business-acceptable threshold established after measurement fixes.
original_recommendation.why_this_matters: A controlled test lets you validate whether the efficient return scales beyond the current spend level without exposing the business to unchecked spend increases.
original_recommendation.expected_impact: Potential to increase free trial signups and impressions while protecting overall efficiency if the channel scales maintain CPA and ROAS.

original_recommendation.why_this_matters: Aligning campaigns to the KPIs (impressions and reach) ensures you're expanding awareness among the intended audience while preserving conversion performance.
original_recommendation.expected_impact: Increased impressions and measurable reach, enabling better evaluation of audience saturation and scale potential for trial signups.
